description: A reusable presentation: the content a person presents (a talk, workshop, poster, or demo), independent of any single occasion on which it is delivered. Delivered at one or more id.sifa.profile.presentationDelivery occasions.

main.description: Record representing a single reusable presentation (the content), distinct from the occasions on which it is delivered.

description.description: Description or abstract of the presentation.

duration.description: Typical length of the presentation, a fixed value or a range, in minutes.

intendedAudiences.description: Intended audiences for this presentation, open text (e.g. 'Engineering leaders', 'Beginners').

links.description: Canonical links for this content, such as slides or a recording.

writeupRef.description: Optional reference to a long-form write-up of this presentation (a pub.leaflet.document or site.standard.document holding video, transcript, or article).

coverImage.description: Optional cover image for the presentation. Rendered as the talk-page hero and OpenGraph image. Max 2 MB, PNG, JPEG, or WebP.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.

duration.description: A presentation length in minutes: a fixed value (minMinutes only) or a range (minMinutes to maxMinutes).

minMinutes.description: Length in minutes, or the lower bound when the length is offered as a range.

maxMinutes.description: Upper bound in minutes when the length is offered as a range. Omit for a fixed length.
